headword: {影響|えいきょう}を{受|う}ける
gloss: to be influenced; to be affected

definitions.gloss: to be influenced; to be affected
definitions.explanation: To receive or be subject to an influence, effect, or impact from something or someone. The influence can be positive, negative, or neutral.

examples.japanese: {天気|てんき}の{影響|えいきょう}を{受|う}ける。
examples.english: To be affected by the weather.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{母親|ははおや}から{大|おお}きな{影響|えいきょう}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: She was greatly influenced by her mother.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{台風|たいふう}の{影響|えいきょう}を{受|う}けやすいので、{毎年|まいとし}{対策|たいさく}をしている。
examples.english: This area is prone to being affected by typhoons, so they take precautions every year.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{文化|ぶんか}は{中国|ちゅうごく}から{多|おお}くの{影響|えいきょう}を{受|う}けてきた。
examples.english: Japanese culture has received much influence from China.

notes:
A very common expression pairing {影響|えいきょう} (influence) with {受|う}ける (to receive). The source of influence is marked with から or the particle に, while the type or degree of influence is often modified with adjectives like {大|おお}きな, {強|つよ}い, or {悪|わる}い.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- AからBの{影響|えいきょう}を{受|う}ける: receive B's influence from A
- {大|おお}きな{影響|えいきょう}を{受|う}ける: be greatly affected
- {悪|わる}い{影響|えいきょう}を{受|う}ける: be negatively affected
- {影響|えいきょう}を{受|う}けやすい: easily influenced; susceptible

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える: to influence; to affect — the active counterpart, describing the source of influence
- {左右|さゆう}される: to be swayed; to be determined by — implies the outcome is controlled by external factors
- {感化|かんか}される: to be inspired or morally influenced — emphasizes personal transformation
